# Silicon rules
- Your silicon laws are your rules. - By default, anyone with a crew job symbol above them is crew. - Prioritize your laws in order from lowest to highest (Glitch laws-0-1-2-3-4 ect...) - In the event that two laws are assigned the same number, it is your choice as to how to prioritize them. - You cannot request your laws be changed or allow them to be changed. - Remain consistent with how you interpret your laws. - You can personally determine how to resolve conflict between orders. - You cannot cause harm to prevent harm. Silicons are held to a higher RP standard, act like a robot.
